items.question: What WNBA teams did Katie Smith play for?
items.answer: Katie Smith starred for the Minnesota Lynx, where she was the 2001 WNBA scoring champion, then won titles with the Detroit Shock in 2006 and 2008 and was the 2008 Finals MVP. She also played for the Washington Mystics, Seattle Storm and New York Liberty, retired in 2013 and later served on the Lynx coaching staff from 2020 to 2024.

items.question: Did Katie Smith play at Ohio State?
items.answer: Yes. Katie Smith played at Ohio State from 1992 to 1996, scored 2,578 points and was the 1996 Big Ten Player of the Year. She returned to Ohio State as an assistant coach on November 11, 2024.

items.question: What were Katie Smith's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Katie Smith averaged 13.4 points, 2.9 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game over her WNBA career, according to her WNBA.com profile. She was inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 2018.

items.question: How many Olympic medals did Katie Smith win?
items.answer: Katie Smith won three Olympic gold medals with Team USA, in 2000, 2004 and 2008.
